jobs.description:
Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed

• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks

• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations

• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background

• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)

• Hands-on and dynamic approach

• Precision and results-oriented mindset

• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility

• Team player who can also work independently

• Preferably experienced in welding

• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

• 

Trilingual: Fluent in English, Dutch, and French (essential! ). 

• 

Skilled and Professional: Strong administrative, linguistic, and interpersonal abilities. 

• 

Self-starter: Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks. 

• 

Well-presented: Classic, professional attire required (no casual wear). 

• 

Reliable and Organized: Punctual, detail-oriented, and proactive. 

Your Responsibilities: 

You are entrusted with overseeing daily operations and ensuring the smooth running of our services. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: 

• 

Welcoming and assisting clients, visitors, and suppliers (EN/NL/FR). 

• 

Managing communications: Answering phones professionally and routing calls as necessary (EN/NL/FR). 

• 

Office Operations: Handling incoming and outgoing mails/packages, filing, data input, and client file management. 

• 

Client Support: Coordinating meeting room and event requests, arranging lunches, and preparing new client offices. 

• 

Problem-Solving: Addressing customer requests, issues, and complaints promptly and professionally. 

• 

KYC – Handling client files in accordance with our obligations under anti-money laundering regulations. 

• 

Administration and Commercial Support: Control, update, and complete client files/data. Process new requests, conduct visits, and be the key to successful new collaborations through meticulous commercial support. 

• 

Facility Oversight: Performing daily checks of common areas, ensuring a tidy and functional workspace, managing stock, and handling kitchen appliances. 

• 

Administrative Reporting: Providing regular reports to management and overseeing office supplies and operations.

- Language, administrative, and interpersonal skills are essential. 

- Computer proficiency: Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.). 

- Multitasking ability: You manage responsibilities efficiently and gracefully. 

- Team player mentality: Though you work independently, you enjoy regular contact with clients and colleagues. 

- Professional ethics: You respect the company, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate appropriate behavior toward colleagues, management, clients, and partners. You know where the boundaries lie.
 

- Commitment: Understanding the responsibilities and requirements associated with a small organisation in a competitive sector.
 

- Punctuality
 

- Working remotely is not possible for this position.
 

- Dress code in line with the neutrality policy – classic and professional attire.

Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

Very good English – essential for the position.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Team Leader Configuration & Marshalling.

The Configuration & Marshalling Team Leader ensures effective preparation, coordination, and follow-up of the team's activities in compliance with company standards and procedures. The role involves allocating work according to weekly objectives and priorities set by the Completion Manager, while also actively participating in daily operational activities and supporting the team when required.

Your role:
Reporting to the Completion Manager your main tasks and responsibilities are:
Team Management:

• Lead and coordinate daily team activities
• Identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions
• Allocate resources based on priorities and objectives
• Monitor skills and ensure development plans
• Ensure compliance with quality standards and company rules
• Manage shift handovers

Daily Operations:

• Perform configuration and marshalling tasks
• Act as technical reference
• Train new employees
• Provide operational backup when needed
Communication & Continuous Improvement:

• Report key issues to the Completion Manager
• Communicate effectively within the team
• Contribute to process improvements

Your profile:

• Secondary education or equivalent experience
• Knowledge of aircraft engine components
• Understanding of quality systems and processes
• ERP and IT proficiency
• Team management skills
• Awareness of logistics risks
• Able to manage priorities and urgent issues
• Able to identify anomalies and suggest improvements
• Working knowledge of French and English required

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 
 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations.

Our client is currently strengthening its Data organization and is looking for a Senior Data Product Owner to take ownership of the HR Data domain.

You will join a multidisciplinary Data team of around 30-40 people, working across several business areas such as HR, Finance and Loyalty.

The organization is progressively implementing a Data Mesh approach, offering an opportunity to play an active role in shaping the way Data Products are managed and delivered.
Description

• Take end-to-end ownership of the HR Data Product, from business needs to delivery and continuous improvement

• Identify, challenge and translate business requirements into clear and actionable Data Product specifications

• Work closely with business stakeholders, key users, Data Engineers, Data Analysts and other technical teams

• Define and prioritize the Data Product roadmap according to business value and organizational priorities

• Contribute actively to the implementation and evolution of the Data Mesh strategy

• Strong practical understanding of Data Mesh concepts and principles

• Solid knowledge of Data Governance and Data Management

• Previous professional experience within the HR/Data domain is required

• Experience in Retail or a comparable large-scale business environment is a strong advantage

• Strong combination of business understanding, functional analysis and technical Data skills

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences

• Flexible mindset and comfortable working in a changing and not yet fully structured environment

• Strong transversal and collaborative approach

• Fluent in French or Dutch and English

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. 

Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.

The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your Role
As a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your Profile
We are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

As an Aircraft Engine Inspector, you play a key role in ensuring quality, safety and airworthiness. Your work directly impacts aircraft performance and passenger safety.

• Performing visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled engine parts following approved procedures
• Evaluating parts, modules or engines (serviceable, repairable or scrap) and recording decisions in the ERP system
• Launching and following up required actions based on inspection findings
• Using the appropriate tools, materials and inspection methods
• Ensuring full traceability by correctly closing inspection tasks
• Defining the future configuration of parts and modules
• Carrying out incoming inspections after repair or purchase
• Performing final inspections after internal repairs

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Guidewire Implementation Product Owner + Business Analyst

• Define and prioritise business and functional requirements

• Build, maintain and prioritise the product backlog

• Translate requirements into clear user stories together with the Business Analysts

• Drive scope and priorities throughout the different delivery phases

• Contribute to solution design and ensure alignment between business and technical teams

• Provide direction and partial leadership to the Scrum team

• Coordinate with stakeholders and project team members across multiple locations

• Greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation

• Previous Guidewire experience, with PolicyCenter being particularly relevant
